rules.summary: Fit declared item extents, gaps, and insets inside one available axis extent.

problem_shapes: declared items must fit one horizontal or vertical extent
fixed columns or rows must fit their available axis
encode_steps: Select the declared horizontal or vertical axis
Read the container extent and each item extent on that axis
Add one gap between adjacent items and both insets
Require total used extent to be at most the available extent
anti_patterns: Do not infer item membership from visual proximity
Do not mix coordinate units in one binding
escalate_when: Wrapping, flexing, or weighted tracks require separate rules

solver_encoding.verification: assert the capacity inequality over a complete model
solver_encoding.synthesis: assert the capacity inequality over explicitly bounded unknowns
formula: sum(item extents) + gap * (item count - 1) + inset_start + inset_end <= available extent

rules.summary: Keep one axis-aligned rectangle inside another with optional padding.

problem_shapes: child must remain inside parent
content must remain inside viewport
encode_steps: Resolve child and parent rectangle edges
Apply non-negative padding to all four boundaries
anti_patterns: Do not apply containment to intentional overlays
Do not infer a parent binding from visual proximity

solver_encoding.verification: assert all four containment inequalities over a complete model
solver_encoding.synthesis: assert all four containment inequalities over bounded unknowns

rules.summary: Separate two axis-aligned rectangles by an optional minimum gap.

problem_shapes: siblings must not overlap
reserved regions must remain separate
encode_steps: Emit left, right, above, or below as a four-way disjunction
anti_patterns: Do not apply to intentional overlays or badges
Do not require separation for hidden elements
escalate_when: Rotated or curved shapes require a geometry preprocessor

solver_encoding.verification: assert at least one separating relation over a complete model
solver_encoding.synthesis: assert at least one separating relation over bounded unknowns
formula: first.right + minimum_gap <= second.left OR second.right + minimum_gap <= first.left OR first.bottom + minimum_gap <= second.top OR second.bottom + minimum_gap <= first.top
